description: List customers, optionally filtered by email, with a result limit.

limit.description: Maximum number of customers to return (default 10).

email.description: Optional email to filter customers by.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a Stripe list envelope (object, url, has_more, data) of customer objects.

description: Get a single customer by its id.

customer_id.description: The id of the customer (cus_ prefix).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the customer object; on failure (customer not found), output contains an error message.
A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created customer object.

description: List products with a result limit.

limit.description: Maximum number of products to return (default 10).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a Stripe list envelope of product objects.

description: List prices, optionally filtered by product, with a result limit.

limit.description: Maximum number of prices to return (default 10).

product.description: Optional product id to filter prices by.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a Stripe list envelope of price objects.

description: Create a payment intent (amount in integer cents), optionally confirming it immediately to record a charge.

amount.description: Amount in integer cents; must be positive.

confirm.description: If true, mark as succeeded and record a charge (default false).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the payment_intent object; on failure (invalid amount or unknown customer), output contains an error message.

description: Get a single payment intent by its id.

pi_id.description: The id of the payment intent (pi_ prefix).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the payment_intent object; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.

description: List charges, optionally filtered by customer, with a result limit.

limit.description: Maximum number of charges to return (default 10).

customer.description: Optional customer id to filter charges by.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a Stripe list envelope of charge objects.

description: Get a single charge by its id.

charge_id.description: The id of the charge (ch_ prefix).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the charge object; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.

description: Create a charge (amount in integer cents).

amount.description: Amount in integer cents; must be positive.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created charge object; on failure (invalid amount or unknown customer), output contains an error message.

description: Refund all or part of a charge.

charge.description: The id of the charge to refund.

amount.description: Optional amount in cents to refund; defaults to the full refundable amount.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the refund object; on failure (unknown charge or invalid amount), output contains an error message.

description: List invoices, optionally filtered by customer and status, with a result limit.

status.description: Optional invoice status to filter by.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a Stripe list envelope of invoice objects.

description: Get a single invoice by its id.

invoice_id.description: The id of the invoice (in_ prefix).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the invoice object; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.

description: Create a draft invoice for a customer.

customer.description: The customer id the invoice is for.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created invoice object; on failure (unknown customer), output contains an error message.

description: List subscriptions, optionally filtered by customer and status, with a result limit.

status.description: Optional subscription status to filter by.
